integrity: The latest source algorithm, its exact-Hessian subspace derivation, clipped curvature rule, and finite-difference Hessian-vector definition were inspected directly. The defect law is algebraic; the bundled replay uses exact rationals for the concrete trajectory and independent numerical checks for the general identity.
scientific_limitations: Exact structural result for symmetric positive-definite quadratics and the positive sampled-curvature branch. The explicit counterexample uses no nonsmooth term and identity preconditioning. It does not claim failure of the source convergence theorem, and the proposed orthogonalization repair is not analyzed globally for nonlinear or nonconvex composite objectives.
title: Curvature clipping destroys exact conjugacy in P2GM_CM, with an exact defect law and repair
